correctness.rationale: For n≥4 the triangular graph has diameter two, and a geodesic triple is precisely three base edges forming a simple length-three path, whether or not there are extra edges in its base graph. For n=3 the graph is complete and no such path exists. A path-free connected component on at least four vertices has a star spanning tree, and an extra leaf edge would give a length-three path through a third leaf. The remaining components are isolated vertices, edges, two-edge stars and triangles. After choosing t disjoint labelled triangles, I independently counted weighted partitions of the remaining n−3t labels into n−k star blocks (each size at least three has as many centre choices as labels). This reproduces all 387 nonnegative determinants for 3≤n≤29 and the sole negative determinant at n=30, k=29. The three coefficients are 4575989857607826108600, 73770312933671827650 and 1208883745669600000; the determinant is −89780688879179441682809722027255477500. Degree n is possible precisely with a triangle decomposition; otherwise a spanning star gives n−1, and hereditary general position gives all lower degrees. Here 30 is the base-set parameter, not the number of vertices of T_30. No conclusion for n>30 was audited.

evidence: The October 13 record determines the entire coefficient array for all n by exp(u exp(uz)−u²z/2+u³z³/6) and a recurrence. Ghorbani et al. determine the maximum cardinality; Di Stefano et al. use the component structure to study the minimum size of a maximal set.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The all-order enumeration subsumes the finite coefficient computation; the scalar cardinality results by themselves do not.

originality.rationale: The exact cutoff is correct. Earlier coverage is at the level of an exact enumeration, not a claim that the earlier record printed 30: the October 13 record already supplies the same all-order generating function and an explicit recurrence for the same labelled coefficient arrays. Applying that recurrence through the exhibited failure and comparing consecutive products yields the complete asserted cutoff without any additional mathematical ingredient. This mechanically implied finite evaluation does not clear the originality bar. The exact November 8 match is later by catalog date and is not the basis for the prior-coverage finding.
residual_risks: No determination of independence or derivation for the later exact match. The adverse comparison is based on the earlier all-order recurrence, not on a claim that the earlier text printed the cutoff.

value.rationale: The first failure is a natural diagnostic of coefficient shape and the integer example can be useful. But the frozen claim gives only a short bounded evaluation of the previously available exact recurrence, with no additional structure or criterion for log-concavity. It does not establish a distinct exact invariant beyond what the prior enumeration mechanically determines.
